item.question: Why is theoretical grounding important in feature selection methods?
item.answer: Theoretical grounding provides guarantees on true feature recovery, ensuring that the method's effectiveness is not just empirical but also supported by theoretical evidence. This adds reliability and predictability to its application in real-world scenarios.
